::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="No project values yet? Start with standard cases"}

- **[New construction and refurbishment](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-renovation):** If both occur, start with the appropriate refurbishment share.

- **[Envelope quality by building age](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-hulls):** For an initial existing-building estimate, choose building type and age, then check actual components.

- **[Geometric shading](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-shading_geometry):** The stored ÖNORM selection provides a starting point; compare it with local shading.

- **[Airtightness](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-air_tightness):** Choose an assumption matching the building standard, such as an older building or new construction with mechanical ventilation.

- **[Thermal mass](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-building_mass):** Assign lightweight, medium or heavy construction as an initial thermal assumption.

- **[Movable solar protection](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-mobile_shading):** Choose the installed type, such as an internal roller blind or external venetian blind.

Check the applied values for your project. [How to apply presets](presets.qmd).

:::
